observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Lontor rechargeable standing fan.
The model number CTL-CF034R-18-C is clearly printed on the box in photo 0.
The box indicates an 18-inch size, a 4.5Ah battery, and a 36-hour maximum runtime.
A 1-year warranty and 6-month battery warranty are mentioned on the packaging.
The actual fan is not visible; only the cardboard packaging is shown.
There is a watermark for 'PROMZY ELECTRONICS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: Battery endurance cannot be confirmed without a timed discharge test.
While printed on the box, a valid warranty requires a stamped card or original receipt from the seller.
This is a logistical arrangement between buyer and seller.

risks.risk: The fan may be missing from the box, used, or physically damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan assembled and out of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional unit for parts

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid or lithium battery may be dead or degraded.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running on battery power alone.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the remote control or charging cable may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the fan alongside its remote and power cord.
risks.if_unproven: as missing the remote and cables

proof_requests: Photo of the actual fan out of the box to confirm condition and presence.
Video of the fan operating on battery power.
Photo of the remote control and charging cable.
Photo of the warranty card or purchase receipt.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the packaging, allowing the item to be priced at its worst-case scenario (non-functional/missing parts) until further proof is provided.
